info.title: LabTrack REST API
info.description: LabTrack v0.6.1: FINAL APPROVED PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS for the synthetic MVP (all 19 answers and OPEN-01–04 approved on 2026-11-01). OpenAPI remains design draft until runtime implementation/contract validation. Exceptional custody uses 2 distinct eligible destination-lab witnesses (one LAB_MANAGER), confirmed Shipment Pickup and separate regional administrative decision; no forged Courier handoff. No domain API implementation.

post.summary: Per-command replay: full response 90 days then tombstone; >24h snapshot REVIEW_REQUIRED, new live action after manual review
post.description: Strict dependency-based stale check: whole Pickup custody phase for Pickup, target Container/Handoff for Delivery; sealed manifest and live Courier auth always checked before replay. Unrelated Shipment.version increments do not cause rejection. Snapshots older than 24h yield stored REVIEW_REQUIRED without custody mutation. Delivery may name an applied same-actor/Shipment/snapshot Pickup using depends_on_command_id, only while current Pickup and target versions exactly equal that predecessor's recorded post-state. No general automatic rebase is allowed.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Optional authorized-region filter. When omitted, return cases across all regions authorized for the caller; when provided, only narrows results. Every item identifies its region.

parameters.name: older_than_seconds
parameters.description: Minimum case age in seconds, measured from the case event or deadline.

get.description: Active REGIONAL_OPERATIONS can view cases across authorized regions. SENDER_OPERATOR sees owned Shipment Pickup/overdue cases; the assigned COURIER sees their own Pickup/Delivery/overdue cases; destination LAB_OPERATOR sees Delivery/overdue cases; destination LAB_MANAGER additionally sees destination pending-proposal cases. REGIONAL_ANALYST receives no case rows. Optional region_id only narrows results. Each item represents one qualifying case; a Shipment may appear multiple times. The source is PostgreSQL business state, independent of notification delivery. Case age is measured from its threshold-driving event or expected-delivery deadline. Total counts cases before pagination; order oldest last_event_at first, then case type, Shipment ID, and nullable case IDs.

expected_delivery_at.description: Optional during DRAFT, required and future at seal; immutable after seal in MVP

manifest_revision.description: Incremented during DRAFT manifest changes, frozen on seal, independent from shipment version

destination_org_id.description: Must equal the configured pilot central destination_lab_id and be revalidated at seal

expected_delivery_at.description: Optional during DRAFT; must be non-null and strictly future at seal

received_at.description: Server time when NORMAL or EXCEPTIONAL receipt was verified; not an untrusted client physical action timestamp.

received_by.description: For NORMAL handoff: actual destination Lab user who confirmed physical receipt. For EXCEPTIONAL evidence: NULL; regional verifier is receipt_evidence.verified_by and physically present Lab witnesses appear as custody_attestations. Never record REGIONAL_OPERATIONS as the physical receiver.

receipt_evidence.description: At most one verified evidence per container, NORMAL or EXCEPTIONAL; server validates eligible evidence before RECEIVED.

ReceiptResultRequest.description: ACCEPTED cannot carry a reason; MISSING and REJECTED require active reason_code matching SAMPLE scope and kind

status.description: SUPERSEDED only for pending Delivery attempt replaced by authorized exceptional evidence, never equivalent to Courier confirmation

container_id.description: NULL for whole-shipment Pickup; required for per-container Delivery

total.description: Distinct Shipments in the Shipment.created_at cohort.

by_status.description: Distinct Shipments grouped by latest current status.

missing_samples.description: Current Sample receipt rows whose result is MISSING.

rejected_samples.description: Current Sample receipt rows whose result is REJECTED.

container_missing.description: Containers whose latest issue outcome is MISSING.

container_rejected.description: Containers whose latest issue outcome is REJECTED.

partially_completed_with_issues.description: Current COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES Shipments with more than zero but fewer than all containers RECEIVED.

average_received_container_delivery_seco.description: Numerator: sum of confirmed Pickup-to-container-receipt durations. Denominator: RECEIVED containers in partially delivered Shipments. Undelivered containers are not zero-duration observations.

average_full_shipment_delivery_seconds.description: Numerator: sum of confirmed Pickup-to-last-confirmed-receipt durations. Denominator: Shipments with every container RECEIVED and the required timestamps. Partially and wholly undelivered Shipments are excluded.

cached_at.description: Legacy response field, not authoritative issuance timestamp; use issued_at

CourierOfflineCommand.description: OPEN-04 approved: relevant dependencies are manifest revision, target Container/Handoff state version (Pickup phase version for Pickup), confirmed Pickup validity, assigned Courier and active authorization. No automatic rebase after relevant change. Unrelated other-container data edits alone do not make command stale.

recorded_at.title: Recorded At
recorded_at.description: Authoritative server timestamp for persisted outcomes; null if not recorded

last_event_at.description: Threshold-driving Handoff/proposal timestamp or Shipment expected_delivery_at deadline.

age_seconds.description: Whole seconds since last_event_at, using the database clock.

StalledShipment.description: One current PostgreSQL-backed stalled case. The same Shipment may have multiple cases. container_id is set for DELIVERY_PENDING and for a PROPOSAL_PENDING case's associated container; proposal_id is set for PROPOSAL_PENDING.

total.description: Total qualifying case count before pagination.

PagedStalledShipment.description: Paged stalled cases; total counts cases, not distinct Shipments.

DecideContainerResolutionProposalRequest.description: Only destination LAB_MANAGER distinct from proposer can decide

total_shipments.description: Distinct current Shipments in this Shipment.created_at bucket.

completed_shipments.description: Current Shipments in COMPLETED or COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES status.

partially_delivered_shipments.description: Shipments with more than zero but fewer than all containers RECEIVED, including COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES Shipments.

sample_issues.description: Count of current receipt rows with MISSING or REJECTED result.

container_issues.description: Count of containers whose latest issue outcome is MISSING or REJECTED.

shipment_count.description: Distinct Shipments associated with this sender or destination organization; each Shipment counts once per organization.

completed_count.description: Associated Shipments currently in COMPLETED or COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES status.

with_issues_count.description: Associated Shipments currently in COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES status.

kind.description: Administrative incident type; distinct from Sample/Container discrepancy kinds MISSING/REJECTED.

resolved_by.description: REGIONAL_OPERATIONS actor who recorded separate administrative decision; never impersonates Courier/other absent actor.

resolution.description: Administrative outcome, not a Courier signature. Only EXCEPTIONAL_RECEIPT_VERIFIED can create verified exceptional receipt evidence and mark container RECEIVED in the same transaction.

CustodyAttestationRequest.description: Server selects valid variant from incident.phase; Pickup: active origin SENDER_OPERATOR. Delivery: active destination Lab witness, personally present. Exactly 2 distinct destination lab staff with >=1 LAB_MANAGER needed for exceptional receipt. JWT actor only; no proxy confirmations.

role_at_time.description: Recorded from active membership by server; user-supplied role/identity is ignored.

container_code.description: Null for Pickup attestations, where a container does not apply.

statement.description: Personal assertion of observed facts; independent witnesses use separate JWT identities and cannot count twice under multiple roles.

resolution.description: EXCEPTIONAL_RECEIPT_VERIFIED only for eligible DELIVERY incident and already CONFIRMED whole-Shipment Pickup plus two distinct eligible witnesses with one LAB_MANAGER. NO_PHYSICAL_TRANSFER only for Pickup with Sender attestation; no Pickup confirmation/cancel side effect. Others change no custody.

method.description: NORMAL: confirmed distinct Courier + Lab delivery. EXCEPTIONAL: two eligible destination Lab employee attestations (one LAB_MANAGER), confirmed Shipment Pickup, separate REGIONAL_OPERATIONS administrative decision. Not a forged Courier handoff.

verified_by.description: Actor validating method-specific evidence; EXCEPTIONAL is regional administrative resolver, not a physical lab receiver. Lab eyewitness identities are stored separately.

physical_release_occurred.description: NULL when Sender cannot establish physical release; NOT a Courier confirmation

containers_at_origin.description: Sender's personal observation of whether all Shipment containers remain at origin

physically_present.description: User personally asserts physical presence with the named container; not independently verified by software
